605:t_031:5.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Then I'll wake you up.」

605:t_032:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「The targets are $c. We will punish them.」

605:t_032:7.en:
$$アサキム$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$... Do you still intend to underestimate them?」

605:t_032:8.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I'm only ever taking the best course of action for them and for the world.」

605:t_032:9.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Come now, $c. Show me you can live up to my expectations.」

605:t_032:10.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Another one of your favorite condescending taunts, huh!」

605:t_032:11.en:
$$シモン$$
「It's about time you talked! Who you really are and what you're after!」

605:t_032:12.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「On my end, I'm ready at any time. All that remains is whether you can climb up to where I am.」

605:t_032:13.en:
$n
「Then, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$...! You're going to tell us everything right here!」

605:t_033:0.en:
$$葵$$
「He's strong...! He's different from the way he's been until now!」

605:t_033:1.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Damage isn't getting through, just like that black $$アンゲロイ$$!」

605:t_033:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Your eye for detail isn't bad. There really is joy in fighting you.」

605:t_033:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I find myself wanting your cooperation all the more.」

605:t_034:1.en:
???
「Same as ever, you're so damn refreshing it makes me sick.」

605:t_035:0.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「This time I'm finally putting you down for good, you bastard.」

605:t_035:1.en:
$n
「$$ガドライト#pilot$$! $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$!?」

605:t_035:2.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「It's been a while, Imitation Boy...」

605:t_035:3.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「Is what I'd like to say, but it looks like your machine has already surpassed my $$ジェミニア#robot$$.」

605:t_035:5.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「I'm just stubbornly dragging out my shameful life.」

605:t_035:6.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「Still, to use the pride of the $$ジェミナイド$$ without permission and then toss it aside once it's no longer needed...」

605:t_035:8.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「Don't let it bother you, lady. I'm not the kind of man who has any right to lecture others, either.」

605:t_035:9.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Did you come to fight us again?」

605:t_035:10.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「I've got plenty I want to say to you lot. But first... dealing with that guy comes first.」

605:t_035:11.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「I'm already neither with the $$サイデリアル$$ nor the $$ジェミニス$$ anymore...」

605:t_035:12.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「But you're the one I can't let off the hook, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!」

605:t_035:13.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「How pathetic, $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$. Even with your $$スフィア$$ taken and the woman you loved most lost, you still keep fighting.」

605:t_035:14.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「Sorry to 《$$アンナロッタ$$》, but right now I've got other women who are dearest to me.」

605:t_035:15.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「For their sake too, I'm going to take you down with my own hands...!」

605:t_035:17.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「That's how it is, $n. I won't ask you to lend a hand, and I've no intention of helping you either.」

605:t_035:18.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「I'm going to do things my own way!」

605:t_035:19.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$$セツコ$$, $$ランド$$, $$クロウ$$, $n... $$アウストラリス$$, $$エルーナルーナ$$, $$尸空#pilot$$, $$バルビエル$$... And $$アサキム$$, $$ガドライト#pilot$$...」

605:t_035:20.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「None of you understand anything.」

605:t_036:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Using Resurrection twice in a row is rough, after all.」

605:t_037:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I won't let you escape.」

605:t_038:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You know it too, don't you, $$アサキム$$? That defeating me here is pointless.」

605:t_038:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Don't think things will go your way forever.」

605:t_038:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I see... So you intend to make me show my hand here.」

605:t_038:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Very well. I'll let myself be taken in by that cheap provocation.」

605:t_039:2.en:
$$セツコ$$
「That's... the true form of $$アスクレプス$$...!?」

605:t_039:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$$アサキム$$! This is what you wanted to see!」

605:t_041:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Death is meaningless to him. You know that as well, don't you?」

605:t_041:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「That's not a line you say with a smile.」

605:t_041:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Yes... this is $$ヘリオース$$. My wings.」

605:t_041:5.en:
$$万丈$$
「So it bears the name of the sun god.」

605:t_041:6.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Until we meet again, $c. With your power, the universe can be saved.」

605:t_041:7.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I look forward to seeing you advance along the path of $$シンカ$$.」

605:t_042:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「What the hell is that guy!」

605:t_042:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「He used the word $$シンカ$$, but it seems to carry a different nuance from the evolution we talk about.」

605:t_042:2.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「To speak such a word... Is that man the Administrator of humanity that $$エルガン・ローディック$$ spoke of...?」

605:t_042:3.en:
$$グラハム$$
「But he said that the Administrator of humanity is the $$サイデリアル$$.」

605:t_042:4.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$ガドライト#pilot$$... I'd like you to tell us what you know.」

605:t_042:5.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「I don't owe you that much.」

605:t_042:7.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「Don't get the wrong idea, $n. I've no intention of playing buddy-buddy with you lot.」

605:t_042:8.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「If you're of use to me, I'll just use you, that's all.」

605:t_042:10.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「Remember this. You're the man who took my $$スフィア$$ from me.」

605:t_042:11.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「If you can't master it, this time I'll take the $$スフィア$$ from you.」

605:t_043:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「That man now... at least he isn't our enemy.」

605:t_043:3.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I can tell he's changed a little... I don't sense any resignation in him now.」

605:t_043:4.en:
$$アマタ$$
「So in the end, we still don't know who $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ really is...」

605:t_043:5.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Before we think about what we don't know, we've got enemies to defeat.」

605:t_044:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「The $$サイデリアル$$ have lurked in the shadows of the histories of many worlds, managing humanity...」
